title: Pontotoc County Library opens sign-ups for a holiday bow workshop for seniors
excerpt: Betty Crane will demonstrate floral arranging Dec. 7. The library will provide craft supplies and lunch, and seniors can reserve a place by phone or in person.
locality: Pontotoc County Library in Pontotoc, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Seniors can sign up now to make a holiday bow at the Pontotoc County Library on Monday, Dec. 7. The workshop begins at 10 a.m. at 111 N. Main St. in Pontotoc.

Betty Crane, whom the library identifies as a master floral arranger, will give an arrangement demonstration. The library will provide supplies for participants to make their own bows, along with lunch.
Space is limited. To reserve a place, call the Pontotoc branch at 662-489-3960 or stop by the library. Its regular Friday hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and it opens Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
